zoe: Heads up - trying to integrate the JS SDK into an Expo app (Hermes). Metro resolves the ESM import (exports.import -> dist/index.mjs) and the app crashes: global.crypto undefined, ReadableStream missing, and Hermes complains about Symbol.asyncIterator. Anyone have a compact set of fixes?

frank: Seen this. Metro will prefer the import entry if exports has import. Quick fixes: 1) alias to the CJS file in metro, or 2) import the CJS directly via require().

maya: Minimal metro alias we use:```js
// metro.config.js
const path = require('path')
module.exports = { resolver: { extraNodeModules: { 'my-sdk$': path.resolve(__dirname, 'node_modules/my-sdk/dist/index.cjs') } } }
```

zoe: Nice. At runtime we still get getRandomValues / AbortController issues and stream iteration errors.

frank: Polyfills we add: `react-native-get-random-values`, `abortcontroller-polyfill`, and `web-streams-polyfill/ponyfill`. Also patch Symbol.asyncIterator on Hermes if missing:```js
if (!Symbol.asyncIterator) Symbol.asyncIterator = Symbol.for('asyncIterator')
```

maya: TypeScript pain: the SDK d.ts pulls in `node:stream` and tsc drags in Node lib defs. We set `skipLibCheck: true` or add a tiny local `declare module 'node:stream'` shim to unblock. Upstream should publish RN-friendly types.

zoe: I want to open a GH issue. What concrete asks should I list?

frank: Ask for: 1) a `react-native` or `main` pointing to a CJS/UMD RN build, 2) ensure `exports` has require fallback, 3) a lightweight browser/RN bundle without Node-only deps, 4) separate type defs that avoid `node:` imports, 5) docs for RN/Expo (metro + polyfills). Also request tree-shakeable flags to disable streaming code.

build-bot: Build note: included tests fail on CI when running with jsdom because SDK picks ESM path; adding cjs alias to jest resolver fixed it.

expo-bot: FYI Expo SDK 48+ exposes `crypto.getRandomValues` in managed runtime; custom dev clients and older SDKs may still need polyfills. See https://blog.expo.dev/

maya: I'll help draft the repro (expo prebuild + Hermes) and the metro logs. Zoe, ping me when you create the issue and I'll add the repro steps and the metro snippet.

zoe: Thanks all — I'll open the issue and attach a tiny expo repo that reproduces the errors. :thumbsup:
